verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI video-generation platform, since vendors in this category can release model weights or on-prem deployments, so the axis applies. Every piece of evidence describes a hosted offering: a cloud API with keys, credit billing, a browser workspace, and vendor-provided dedicated capacity. Nothing documents self-hostable software, downloadable models or on-prem deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
